newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V JUVENTUS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER UNITED V JUVENTUS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League group C match between Manchester United of England and Italy's Juventus at Old Trafford:
Manchester United: 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 4-David May, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 28-Phil Neville, 8-Nicky Butt, 10-David Beckham, 7-Eric Cantona, 11-Ryan Giggs, 16-Roy Keane, 20-Ole Solskjaer.

Juventus: 1-Angelo Peruzzi; 5-Sergio Porrini, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 4-Paolo Montero, 3-Moreno Torricelli, 21-Zinedine Zidane 7-Angelo Di Livio, 14-Didier Deschamps, 9-Alen Boksic, 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 10-Alessandro del Piero.
